option_relations.rationale: High-degree AV block is a general term and not directly equivalent to His-Purkinje Disease. While His-Purkinje disease can cause high-degree AV block, the option is not specific enough to be a direct relation to the provided leaf.

Infrahisian Mobitz type I second-degree AV block (Wenckebach phenomenon occurring in His-Purkinje system) is a specific type of conduction abnormality that occurs within the His-Purkinje system, making it a subtype of His-Purkinje Disease.

Bradyarrhythmia due to conduction system disease is a broader category that encompasses His-Purkinje Disease, as His-Purkinje Disease is a specific type of conduction system disease leading to bradyarrhythmia.
Progressive cardiac conduction disease is a broader term that includes His-Purkinje Disease, as His-Purkinje Disease is a form of progressive cardiac conduction disease.
